_comment: Hinglish narration for the animated card reels. ⭐ WRITE THE HINDI IN DEVANAGARI AND LEAVE ENGLISH WORDS IN LATIN. Latin-transliterated Hindi makes the model guess: it produced a stutter on the opening word (a-agar), split nine into ni-ne, and stretched vowels (mangaaal, vaajah). Devanagari removes the guessing. ⭐ Numerals go in Devanagari transliteration of the ENGLISH words (नाइन, एटीन, ट्वेंटी-सेवन) - which is exactly what the whisper transcript of reference #3 (41.2K likes) showed a real numerologist saying. Bare digits get read as formal Hindi numerals. `narrate:false` keeps a field on the card but out of the voiceover. 🪤 Do NOT use the ॐ glyph in narration text - the model spells it out letter by letter as A-U-M. Write ओम instead. The glyph is fine ON SCREEN, just not in what gets spoken.
